summary: A fantastic opportunity for an investor looking for a ready-made rental investment, this two-bedroom mid-terraced property is currently tenanted and producing a rental income of £475 per calendar month. The property offers an established income from the outset and is ideally suited to an investor
description:
Situated on Bright Street in Hartlepool, the property is conveniently positioned for a range of local amenities, shops, schools and public transport links. Hartlepool town centre is within easy reach, offering a wider selection of shopping, leisure and recreational facilities, including Middleton Grange Shopping Centre. The surrounding area also benefits from a range of convenience stores and everyday amenities, while Hartlepool railway station provides rail connections to the wider area. The location is also well placed for access to the surrounding Tees Valley and major road networks. The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance lobby leading into the hallway, with access to the principal ground-floor accommodation and stairs rising to the first floor. The lounge provides a comfortable reception space and is open plan to the dining area, creating a versatile area for both relaxing and entertaining. The kitchen is positioned to the rear of the property and provides a range of fitted wall and base units together with work surfaces and space for the usual appliances. To the first floor there are two bedrooms, offering comfortable sleeping accommodation, together with a family bathroom fitted with the usual suite. Externally, the property benefits from a rear enclosed courtyard providing a low-maintenance outside space. There is also a useful brick-built storage building to the rear which is currently utilised as a utility room, providing valuable additional space for washing and storage. Offered to the market with no chain, viewings are available immediately.

ENTRANCE LOBBY Accessed via a UPVC-framed double-glazed entrance door, with a further door leading into the hallway.

ENTRANCE HALL Having a radiator and stairs rising to the first floor, with access leading to the principal ground-floor accommodation.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING ROOM The open-plan lounge/dining room offers spacious accommodation. The lounge features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator, while the dining area benefits from a further UPVC-framed double-glazed window, a wall-mounted combination gas central heating boiler, radiator, under-stair storage cupboard and feature fire surround.

KITCHEN The kitchen is fitted with a range of base and wall-mounted units with laminated work surfaces, incorporating an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is space for a cooker and fridge freezer, along with a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and UPVC door providing access to the rear courtyard.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first-floor landing features a radiator, built-in storage cupboard and provides access to the bedrooms and bathroom.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a well-proportioned double bedroom featuring a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two features a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and radiator.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panelled bath with electric shower over, WC and vanity area. The walls are tiled to the splash and vanity areas, and there is a UPVC-framed double-glazed window.

EXTERNALLY Externally, there is an enclosed rear courtyard with gated access, together with a brick-built storage building currently utilised as a utility room, with plumbing provided for an automatic washing machine.
